events.text: PETRONAS Dagangan Berhad formally adopted the PETRONAS Commitment to Net Zero Carbon Emissions by 2050, according to its 2025 Sustainability Report.
PETRONAS Dagangan Berhad solarised 121 additional stations in fiscal year 2025, bringing the cumulative solarised network to 303 sites.

PETRONAS Dagangan Berhad's Sustainability Action Committee (SAC) and Board Sustainability and Risk Committee (BSRC) oversee climate-related risks, opportunities and other sustainability-related matters.
PETRONAS Dagangan Bhd published its Integrated Report titled 'Thriving Forward' on March 17, 2025.

Syed Zainal, a former non-independent and non-executive director at PETRONAS Dagangan Bhd, said a safety review was urged a year after the gas pipeline explosion, explaining the 2,623km gas pipeline network in Peninsular Malaysia.
The Industrial Court awarded a former aircraft refueller RM86,450 in compensation and back wages after ruling his dismissal by Petronas Dagangan Berhad was without just cause or excuse.
Mohd Taufik bin Mohd Aris was dismissed by Petronas Dagangan Berhad on December 22, 2022, over alleged misconduct including falsifying attendance records and forging signatures on training documents.
